title: The coordinator's release check also runs merge-tree against the open batch head, not main only
why: Coordinator 16:50 CST Nov 10: #2413 passed the release check at 16:21 CST, then conflicted with #2382 inside batch 74.
note: Owner of the code: the coordinator's release-check script (step release-check-script). The retrospective session sent the same step at 16:59 CST as release-check-vs-batch. Express lane started 12:43 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 12:44 CST): session_013NEJL27Zw8otLsDBqaNN61, with step one-owner-per-pr. Lane question 15:26 CST Nov 13 (lane session_013NEJL27Zw8otLsDBqaNN61, PR #3240 head 2d6679d6e; lane reading, unread by triage): runner 10 says #3240 conflicts with main 59da758a3. The lane measured on that main: merge/merge.py:4152 "Nothing here builds or drops a batch"; no batch-build or batch-drop command; release_check (4023) takes no batch heads. But skills/ci-hygiene/SKILL.md line 59 still says the batch rules "stay live until the cutover (decision all-repos-switch-together)" and line 86 says each lane merges alone. Lane option (a): rule the step stale, close #3240, archive the branch to archive/lane/release-check-vs-batch-head, mark the step dropped. Option (b): merge main in, settle merge.py and test_merge.py conflicts, fresh record. No past ruling found on this step. Routed to the coordinator (precedent: its 15:24 pick dropping drain-batch-measure); lane waits and pushes nothing. Sibling #3231 (one-owner-per-pr) unaffected. Skill and tool disagree on whether batching is live: step ci-hygiene-batch-text-stale. Child-repo read 15:28 CST Nov 13 (runner 11, 15:27): five child repos still built batches today on the old merge install (q_max, ios-adblock, banchi, mailaudit, degen), so option (a) would drop the check for repos that still batch; see ci-hygiene-batch-text-stale. Coordinator rules.
